bootstrapExamples.note: Actual HTML attribute is read into renderer dependency and paired ready; bind echoes both IDs.
Missing carrier preserves legacy Raw and native keyboard controls.
No trimming, uppercasing or synthetic client host ID.
A well-shaped foreign viewId is ignored, never adopted.
One bounded early ready can register when its legacy ready arrives.
Same-pair duplicate is idempotent and preserves action replay state.
Host replacement revokes old view/projection/action authority.
Reuse with a new browser UUID renews HTML once; queued old pairs cannot renew the new lease.
Expiry cannot grant registration later without a fresh explicit companion.ready.
Current generation guard rejects queued work before state/action dispatch.
View switches/projection resync do not recreate HTML or the CLI.
Existing manual renderer consumer remains valid with the optional dependency absent.
Duplicate early ready does not extend the two-second deadline.
Empty view registers without inventing a session/generation or bind.
Later real selection binds the already-registered document.
Companion pairing capacity does not alter legacy hydration or grow without bound.
No client identity is manufactured for a legacy renderer without UUID.
A reloaded document cannot accept an old-document bind during host renewal.
